integrity: The coordinate identity is derived directly from the original BiCGSTAB first-cycle formulas. The sharp lower and upper envelopes follow from endpoint concavity and a Kantorovich-type bound, with explicit asymptotic three-mode sharpness constructions. The embedded verifier uses exact rational arithmetic only for witnesses and algebraic replay; finite checks are not used as proof of the universal statements.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic first completed unpreconditioned BiCGSTAB cycle for positive diagonal systems, zero start, and standard shadow residual equal to the initial residual. Later cycles, alternative shadow residuals, preconditioning, nondiagonal matrices, nonsymmetric M-matrices, breakdown handling, and finite precision are not classified.
title: Sharp first-cycle component envelope for BiCGSTAB on positive diagonal systems
